name: Translate
summary: Translate text on the shelf, on your Mac, totally offline
description: Type or paste text on the shelf and translate it between any two languages you choose, entirely on your Mac. Auto-detect the source language, swap languages in one click, translate while typing, and copy, paste, or listen to results. Powered by Apple's on-device Translation framework, no network, accounts, or API keys, nothing ever leaves your Mac.
